seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Salisbury, NC 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Salisbury and Spencer, NC: THE POLAR EXPRESS train ride, Holiday Night Out, Mrs. Claus events and China Grove traditions.
lede: Salisbury and Rowan County do Christmas with a downtown Holiday Night Out, a Polar Express train ride in Spencer and small town events in China Grove and Landis.
celebrates: Downtown Salisbury hosts Holiday Night Out each December, with free photos with Santa, a cocoa crawl and a toy making stop. In Spencer, the N.C. Transportation Museum runs THE POLAR EXPRESS, and the N.C. Museum of Dolls, Toys and Miniatures hosts Mrs. Claus for tea and cookies. China Grove holds a tree lighting at Hanna Park, a Mrs. Claus storytime at Town Hall and a pancake breakfast with Santa at Magnolia Grove. Rowan County's visitor bureau also lists a Southern Rowan Christmas Parade through Landis and China Grove each November.
lastyear: The Southern Rowan Christmas Parade, which travels through Landis and China Grove, and the Salisbury 'Tis the Season Spectacular parade fall in the days around Thanksgiving. This year Visit Rowan County lists the Southern Rowan parade on November 24 followed by Landis's tree lighting, and the Salisbury parade on November 25. The county's visitor bureau publishes a holiday parade and tree lighting guide each autumn so families can plan the season in advance.
facts: The N.C. Transportation Museum in Spencer sells admission from $10, or $20 with a 25 minute train ride, according to our museum guide. Holiday Night Out in Downtown Salisbury is an annual tradition where downtown businesses stay open later, and the downtown group calls it the biggest shopping night of the year. Spencer's doll and toy museum includes museum entry from 10 am to 4 pm with its Mrs. Claus tea ticket.
trains: Salisbury and Spencer are the best train towns in this part of North Carolina. THE POLAR EXPRESS train ride runs at the N.C. Transportation Museum in Spencer, with cocoa, cookies and Santa, according to Visit Rowan County. The museum also sells a 25 minute train ride with admission. Our Spencer museum page has ticket and train ride details for families planning a visit during the Christmas season.
train_links: Train rides and, at Christmas, THE POLAR EXPRESS at the old Spencer Shops.
traditions: A holiday train ride at the N.C. Transportation Museum in Spencer.

kidfact: At the Holiday Night Out in downtown Salisbury, children can make a toy in Santa's Workshop and follow a hot cocoa crawl.
faq: Where can kids ride a Christmas train near Salisbury?

THE POLAR EXPRESS train ride runs at the N.C. Transportation Museum in Spencer, with cocoa, cookies and Santa, according to Visit Rowan County. The museum is in Spencer, next to Salisbury. Tickets sell out, so check the museum's site first.
Is there a free Santa photo in Salisbury?
Yes. Holiday Night Out on December 4 offers free photos with Santa in Downtown Salisbury from 5 to 8 pm, with check in at City Hall, 217 S. Main Street.
What is happening in China Grove?
China Grove holds a free tree lighting at Hanna Park on November 28, a free storytime with Mrs. Claus at Town Hall on December 17 and a $25 Breakfast with Santa at Magnolia Grove on December 19.
Is there a Christmas parade in Salisbury?
The Salisbury parade took place on November 25 and the Southern Rowan parade through Landis and China Grove on November 24, according to Visit Rowan County. Both are before this page's events.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Salisbury for 2026, and here is what he found: 6 family events, 3 of them free. The magic runs from November 28 (China Grove Christmas Tree Lighting) through December 19 (Breakfast with Santa at Magnolia Grove), with THE POLAR EXPRESS train ride in Spencer, Holiday Night Out (December 4) and Cookies, Cocoa and Christmas with Mrs. Claus (December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Salisbury

  • 6 Christmas events for kids in Salisbury
  • 3 free events: Holiday Night Out, the China Grove tree lighting and Storytime with Mrs. Claus
  • Meet Santa: free photos at Holiday Night Out, Mrs. Claus at the doll museum and at China Grove Town Hall, and Breakfast with Santa at Magnolia Grove
  • Trains: THE POLAR EXPRESS train ride at the N.C. Transportation Museum in Spencer
  • Season: November 28, 2026 to December 23, 2026
